lycanthrope.groundStratum: Depth 65 · Limestone · Mantle (Source Band: Second Tier)
lycanthrope.cosmologicalOrigin: Mantle Limestone · corrupted Watcher/Nephilim splice in living blood; Witch governs the change, she is not the splice’s source
lycanthrope.polarianAspect: Subject to the Oblique Turning of the Orrery
lycanthrope.observedWindowState: I. In the Skin of Man
lycanthrope.answeringSentence: Answered by The Witch (Depth 65, Limestone): For she alone keeps the measure of the root, the fat, and the lunar tide by which the wolf is either called to the skin or quieted within the man.

vampire.groundStratum: Depth 55 · Shale · Mantle (Source Band: Second Tier)
vampire.cosmologicalOrigin: Mantle Shale · grafted contagion of humour and heat-debt under Enchantress instruments
vampire.polarianAspect: Subject to the Oblique Turning of the Orrery
vampire.answeringSentence: Answered by The Enchantress (Depth 55, Shale): For though the house has gone cold, it hunts by her own instruments—voice, aspect, and the persuasion of the blood—and cannot cross a threshold where her art has already barred the will.

sidhe.cosmologicalOrigin: Living Web (Cosmological Tier 3) · sky-fed court of the Grid; winter is an observed Aspect, not permanent dormancy
sidhe.polarianAspect: Web-grounded; seasons turn about the Spindle’s soil foot
sidhe.answeringSentence: Answered by The Druid (Altitude 40, The Vault): For their court turns not with the soil below, but with the sky-fed Grid and the hinges of the year that only the Keeper of the Living Web may reckon.

kitsune.cosmologicalOrigin: Living Web (Cosmological Tier 3) · long tally of sky-seasons bound in living fur
kitsune.polarianAspect: Web-grounded; seasons turn about the Spindle’s soil foot
kitsune.answeringSentence: Answered by The Druid (Altitude 40, The Vault): For each tail is a long tally of the sky's seasons bound into living fur, answering to the law of the Web rather than the law of the snare.

orc.groundStratum: Depth 65 · Limestone · Mantle (Source Band: Second Tier)
orc.cosmologicalOrigin: Mantle Limestone · vat-brine chemistry cultivated into a fungal soil pod (pot origin + earth growth)
orc.polarianAspect: Subject to the Oblique Turning of the Orrery
orc.observedWindowState: I. In the Soil Pod, of Vat Descent
orc.answeringSentence: Answered by The Witch (Depth 65, Limestone): For what is bred without a mother in the blind chemistry of the pot and the limestone vat, and set to grow in the dark soil, knows no master save the hand that mixed its brine.

troll.groundStratum: Depth 75 · Basalt · Mantle (Source Band: Second Tier)
troll.cosmologicalOrigin: Mantle Basalt · cooled column given slow breath; granite-looking masonry is Bay material, lore remains Basalt compact
troll.polarianAspect: Subject to the Oblique Turning of the Orrery
troll.answeringSentence: Answered by The Warlock (Depth 75, Basalt): For it is the cooled column of the basalt itself given slow breath, and yields neither to iron nor plea, but only to the older compacts signed beneath the hill.

golem.groundStratum: Depth 90 · Granite · Mantle (Source Band: Second Tier)
golem.cosmologicalOrigin: Mantle Granite · fabricated Emptied House of river-clay and inscription; animated under Necromancer string
golem.polarianAspect: Subject to the Oblique Turning of the Orrery
golem.answeringSentence: Answered by The Necromancer (Depth 90, Granite): For though it was never born of woman, it is an Emptied House of river-clay and crushed granite that wakes or sleeps by the same heavy string that moves the dead.

unicorn.cosmologicalOrigin: Upper Vault · First Measure probability walking in clean water and Grid; Paladin favour reveals the horn
unicorn.answeringSentence: Answered by The Paladin (Altitude 80, The Vault): For no hound nor spear may corner a beast that walks inside the sky's improbability; it shows its horn only where the favour of the Vault is already held.
unicorn.secondaryTracking: Wizard may note probability threads; answering remains Paladin

minotaur.cosmologicalOrigin: Horizon · congenital Fire-Bringer thickening of Watcher-line blood-fire (not a craft-made tourist graft); migrate live craft-graft wording
minotaur.polarianAspect: Unspooled Horizon current; Orrery cannot throttle it
minotaur.answeringSentence: Answered by The Sorcerer (On the Horizon): For the heat that thickens its brow and agitates its frame is the same congenital fire that runs unbidden in the Sorcerer's own blood.
minotaur.ancestryNote: Watcher-line blood-fire (ancestry aligns with Sorcerer seat)

fae.cosmologicalOrigin: Living Web (Cosmological Tier 3) · unbodied threshold presence; waiting is active absence of open agreement
fae.polarianAspect: Web-threshold; Spindle seen by ingestion, not command
fae.observedWindowState: I. Waiting at the Threshold of Sight
fae.answeringSentence: Answered by The Shaman (Altitude 55, The Vault): For they stand perpetually at the edge of common sight, waiting until the Keys of Ingestion have opened the door of the eye to the Living Web.

will-o-the-wisp.cosmologicalOrigin: Upper Vault · First Measure stray calculation in wetland Grid; Wizard answers; Shaman may track secondarily
will-o-the-wisp.answeringSentence: Answered by The Wizard (Altitude 75, The Vault): For it is a stray lantern of ungrounded calculation fallen from the upper air, and only the Reckoner of Probable Things may distinguish its false marsh-beacon from a true star.
will-o-the-wisp.secondaryTracking: Shaman may perceive wetland charge; answering remains Wizard

ophanim.groundStratum: Altitude 100 · Sealed Light · First Measure access
ophanim.cosmologicalOrigin: First Measure (Cosmological Tier 2) of Sealed Light access · revolving rings; Cleric endures, does not command
ophanim.answeringSentence: Answered by The Cleric (Altitude 100, The Sealed Light): For no unvetted eye may look upon the revolving rings of the Sealed Light and remain whole; only the bearer of the restorative signal may endure their watching.

djinn.cosmologicalOrigin: Horizon · smokeless Fire-Bringer plasma under eight-point seal; chance-bending live lore bridges to thermal containment medium
djinn.polarianAspect: Indifferent to the Spindle; bound to Furnace and brass
djinn.answeringSentence: Answered by The Alchemist (On the Horizon): For smokeless fire owes no fealty to sky or stone, yet it may be weighed, cooled, and bound within leaded brass by one who serves nothing but the Furnace.

lich.groundStratum: Depth 90 · Granite · Mantle (Source Band: Second Tier)
lich.cosmologicalOrigin: Mantle Granite · Emptied House decoy whose life-seat rests in external reliquary after operator externalization or Watcher overwrite
lich.polarianAspect: Subject to the Oblique Turning of the Orrery
lich.answeringSentence: Answered by The Necromancer (Depth 90, Granite): For only a master of the Emptied House can look upon a robed king and see that the figure before him is merely a dressed decoy, pulled by a thread from ninety fathoms down.

wraith.groundStratum: Depth 35 · Loess · Mantle (Source Band: Second Tier)
wraith.cosmologicalOrigin: Mantle Loess · bitter acoustic imprint in wind-laid silt; nobody captive inside; Bard resolves the note
wraith.polarianAspect: Acoustic column parallel to the Spindle
wraith.answeringSentence: Answered by The Bard (Depth 35, Loess): For a Wraith is no body at all, but a bitter note pressed into the wind-laid silt, which plays on without rest until the Acoustician strikes the chord that resolves it.

succubus.groundStratum: Depth 75 · Basalt · Mantle (Source Band: Second Tier)
succubus.cosmologicalOrigin: Mantle Basalt · clause/consent intrusion via sleeper’s desire; Warlock answers only; bridge live low-sound/heavy-air to Counter-Contract law
succubus.polarianAspect: Deep shadow where the Spindle’s light fails
succubus.answeringSentence: Answered by The Warlock (Depth 75, Basalt): For she enters the chamber not by the latch, but by an unguarded clause in the sleeper's own desire, and is dismissed only by the law of the Counter-Contract.
succubus.sharedMediumNote: Enchantress may bar will by persuasion medium; Answering Practitioner remains Warlock only
